about: Which entries the weekly lint compares with which sections of health_roadmap_algorithm.md (tools/knowledge-lint-compare.ts, entry-vs-algorithm). headings are exact heading text without the #s; a renamed heading stops the run. terms pick paragraphs from entries longer than 24,000 characters. nouns overrides a reference's first keyword as the word other references must name for a pairing (whole word, plural allowed; case-sensitive if it has a capital). A pairing choice, not clinical content: the loop may propose changes here in its report.

masters.about: US-50 AC7. productIngredients: handles of masters whose topic is a MicroVitamin ingredient; a DOI in their current view that docs/products.md lacks is a warning in test:all. places: where a master's topic lives outside the master (products.md block, evidence.ts id, diet-guideline line, answer-bank entry, system-prompt rule), each {topic: master handle, file: repo-relative, snippet: text anchor, never a line number}. The weekly lint flags a place that did not change when the master's current view did; a deliberate non-change is waived in lint-allowlist.json (rule master-places, item '<file>: <snippet>') with who and date. Both lists start empty and grow with the batches.
